_meta.description: State revenue authority directory (brief §4-7, §22, §32). verification_status reflects how each row was actually obtained — this file does NOT claim uniform verification. FULLY_RESEARCHED means a human/agent browsed the live official site and read its content directly (done for Enugu as the required first fully-integrated state, plus the federal layer researched separately in REGULATORY_RESEARCH_REPORT.md). WEBSITE_CONFIRMED means the official domain and authority name were cross-checked via a direct web search returning the authority's own site. LOCATED_SECONDARY_SOURCE_UNVERIFIED means the website/name came from a third-party aggregator (a 2026 tax-portal directory blog) and has NOT yet been independently confirmed against the state's own site — brief §6 requires this distinction to be preserved, not collapsed into a false 'verified'. No tax RATE, THRESHOLD, or DEADLINE for any state other than federal law and Enugu's named legislation is asserted anywhere in this file — those remain 'Requires regulatory verification' per brief §6/§31 until a human researches each state's actual revenue law with the same rigor as the federal pass.
_meta.aggregator_source_used_for_location_only: https://nrsportal.ng/nigeria-36-states-tax-portal-directory-2026/ (third-party blog — used only to LOCATE candidate URLs per brief §2, not as authority for any rule)

states.business_registration_channel: Self-service via portal (OTP-verified) or in-person at any state tax office

states.electronic_receipting: Partial — self-print receipt module explicitly stated as 'not yet available, coming soon' per official FAQ (checked 2026-10-06)
states.api_notes: No developer documentation, sandbox, or integration API found on the official site. The portal (EnuguCMS) is a citizen/business self-service web application, not a documented machine-to-machine API. Per brief §11, this means the EnuguTaxAuthorityAdapter must be a manual/guided-filing adapter, not an automated integration, unless ESIRS later publishes an API.
states.tax_clearance_certificate: Issued via the portal; requires the preceding 3 years to be assessed and paid (per official FAQ)
applicable_laws: Personal Income Tax Act (federal, as amended) — administered at state level for PAYE/direct assessment

coverage_note: 37 of 37 jurisdictions (36 states + FCT) have a row. 1 is FULLY_RESEARCHED (Enugu), 2 are WEBSITE_CONFIRMED (Lagos, FCT), 34 are LOCATED_SECONDARY_SOURCE_UNVERIFIED — each still needs the same browse-the-official-site pass done for Enugu before any of its specific levies, rates, deadlines, or API claims can be used in a calculation. No row in this file authorizes a tax calculation on its own; only the PAYE federal rate table (already verified in rule_seed_data.json) and jurisdiction ROUTING (which state administers which employee) are production-usable today.
